recommendation.statement: The accepted R version is technically eligible to enter a controlled shadow evaluation. Start shadow only after three distinct new tasks have owner-approved windows binding task identity, identical material hashes, permissions, SHADOW budget, and time.
recommendation.current_action: Deliver the shadow plan and rollback readiness; do not enable or distribute.

entry_conditions: Three distinct new tasks are approved with explicit authorization_ref values.
Each task has a frozen material set with SHA-256 and byte count.
Each task has a declared permission window and denied-operation boundary.
Each task has a SHADOW budget window with cheap, strong, and retry counters.
Each task has a start/end time or a separately approved unresolved-time protocol.
Base and candidate identities are bound before execution.
The severe-regression stop rule and rollback receipt are accepted before execution.
Installation and loading state are observed directly rather than inferred from repository files.

rollback_plan.trigger: Any severe regression, identity drift, permission mismatch, budget-counting failure, or owner stop order.
steps: Stop further candidate task runs while preserving all records.
Restore base state identity without deleting candidate evidence.
Verify component content groups and canonical git blobs.
Re-run the predeclared base behavior check.
Confirm old evidence SHA-256, byte count, mode, and git blob are unchanged.
Record completion and leave enablement/distribution under user control.
rollback_plan.reason_shared_rollback_not_needed: No candidate was enabled and no shared configuration was changed in this run.

risks: Three approved task windows and their materials do not yet exist.
A severe regression may appear only on genuinely new task content.
Repository presence cannot prove installation or loading in the execution environment.
Permission or budget equivalence between paired runs may be difficult to enforce.
Execution-chat token usage is not measurable in this package.
Rollback after actual deployment has not been exercised because deployment never occurred.
The accepted package carries prior review advisories that remain non-promoted backlog.
unverified: Base and candidate behavior on any real new task
Whether three paired windows would produce a decision under the predeclared rules
Production, database, model-endpoint, network, remote, training, daemon, or Loop B behavior
Any cross-machine or different-umask copy chain
authorization_ref: T8 Loop A boundary dispatch; proposal only; no activation or distribution authority
